subject: Splinter upload gate: Vendr onboarding & compact CAIQ handoff
messages:
From: Vendr Onboarding <onboarding@vendr.com>
To: rachel_kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendr profile intake - FleetWave (compact CAIQ)

Hi Rachel,

Congrats on choosing Vendr for the vendor portal — I'm the onboarding coordinator. To get FleetWave's profile marked as 'Verified' we need a compact CAIQ answers CSV and a short SOC 2 excerpt (covering scoping statement + last audit date). For most customers we accept either a direct upload to our portal or an S3 presign flow when the customer prefers to keep artifacts in their S3 bucket.

Quick questions so we can pick the right flow:
- Do you want to upload directly into Vendr (we'll send an invite) or do you want to presign with your S3 bucket?
- Any constraints on sharing the SOC 2 (redactions acceptable)?

If you choose presign, we provide a small manifest and a TTL of 7 days for the objects. Otherwise we can send the portal invite to a stencil account (onboarding@fleetwave.com) to drop the artifacts.

Attachment: None yet — manifest link will be generated once flow chosen.

Thanks,
Maya (for Vendr Onboarding)
Vendr Onboarding Team
onboarding@vendr.com

--
THIS EMAIL MAY CONTAIN SCHEDULED LINKS.

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Vendr Onboarding <onboarding@vendr.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Aug 2028 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr profile intake - FleetWave (compact CAIQ)

Maya,

Thanks — we prefer the presign flow for evidence custody reasons. FleetWave's security team asked for a short TTL and that artifacts remain in their S3 bucket until we pull metadata into Vendr.

I'll cut to the key items:
- Acceptable artifacts: SOC 2 excerpt (scoping statement + date), compact CAIQ CSV (we've validated internally), and a manifest file describing object keys + SHA256 thumbprints.
- TTL: please set the presign TTL to 72 hours. Anything longer will require a legal exception.
- Access: presign should be scoped to a one-time PUT with a generated manifest id FLW-9982.

Looping in Karthik for the S3 presign details (service account, IAM policy, and expected response schema). Karthik — can you confirm the minimal IAM statements the Vendr presign flow needs? Also including Olga to handle proof provenance notes in the portal metadata.

Thanks,
Rachel
Principal Security Programs Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Vendr Onboarding <onboarding@vendr.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Aug 2028 13:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr profile intake - FleetWave (compact CAIQ)

Thanks Rachel — confirming the presign approach and the minimal IAM surface.

Karthik (infra) notes for Maya/Vendr:
- Principle: create a short-lived presign token scoped to a single PutObject on the specified key prefix (manifest-driven).
- IAM policy (minimal):
  {
    "Version": "2012-10-17",
    "Statement": [
      { "Effect": "Allow", "Action": "s3:PutObject", "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::fleetwave-onboard/flw-9982/*" }
    ]
  }

- We will generate pre-signed PUT URLs server-side and include a manifest with expected keys + sha256. Vendr should verify the object size and SHA before marking proof as ingested.
- TTL: 72 hours as requested.

Operational asks for Vendr:
- Please return the presign url list as JSON that maps key->url and an ingest callback URL for a 200/201 acknowledgement.
- Include an upload manifest id in the callback payload so we can reconcile automated ingestion with our inventory.

Olga — we'll attach provenance notes to each record (uploader, upload time, original object path) so Vendr can display 'original source' in the portal.

Maya/Vendr — can you confirm the callback schema and whether Vendr will compute/verify SHA256 client-side or server-side after the object is available?

Thanks,
Karthik
Senior Infra Engineer (Redwood Inference)

Hi all,

Thanks — FleetWave is OK with the 72-hour TTL and the scoped Put-only presign. We attached the SOC 2 excerpt (redacted control narratives removed per legal guidance) and the compact CAIQ CSV. We also uploaded a small manifest file into our bucket and included SHA256 checksums.

Attachments (uploaded to S3 via presign):
- fleetwave_SOC2_report_excerpt.pdf (PDF)
- fleetwave_CAiq-answers-compact.csv (CSV)
- s3_presign_instructions.md (plain text, internal)

Vendr: callback id is FLW-9982. Please confirm when ingestion is complete and what metadata fields you will surface (audit date, scoping, uploader identity). Rachel/Olga — let us know if you need anything else for provenance.

Best,
Liz Connors

liz@fleetwave.com
